name: PAN card (new application)
mode_reason: The application, e-KYC with Aadhaar, fee payment and e-PAN download are all online; no centre visit is required.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar card (used for e-KYC and as identity proof)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)
A scanned signature (digital upload)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
optional_documents: An active email address (for the e-PAN PDF and updates)
extra_documents: If e-KYC fails, the portal asks for a physical acknowledgement and proof of identity and address by post
documents: Aadhaar card (used for e-KYC and as identity proof)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)
A scanned signature (digital upload)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
An active email address

costs.label: Application fee
costs.value: shown at checkout on the official portal; paid online

costs.label: Physical PAN card by post
costs.value: optional extra; e-PAN is free to download after issue

where_to_go.office: Nowhere, if e-KYC works — online only
where_to_go.note: If Aadhaar e-KYC fails, visit an authorised PAN service centre (find the list on the NSDL/UTIITSL portal)

processing_time: e-PAN is usually issued within a few working days of a successful application.
warnings: Apply only on the official NSDL or UTIITSL portal; other websites charge extra and are not official
Never pay a PAN fee to a personal UPI account; fees go to the portal
steps: Open the official PAN application portal and choose New PAN for an Indian citizen (Form 49A) with e-KYC and e-sign.
Fill the form with your name exactly as printed on your Aadhaar, plus date of birth and contact details.
Verify with the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Upload your photograph and signature in the sizes the portal asks for.
Pay the application fee shown at checkout on the official portal.
Note the acknowledgement number, track the status, and download the e-PAN PDF once issued.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Aadhaar (update address or demographic details)
mode_reason: Address and demographic updates can be requested online on the myAadhaar portal with document upload; no centre visit is needed for an online update.
compulsory_documents: Your Aadhaar number (12 digits) or Enrolment ID
The mobile number registered with Aadhaar, to receive the OTP
One valid proof of address (recent electricity or water bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, passport, or another document from the UIDAI list)
optional_documents: For a name or date-of-birth change: the supporting proof listed on the portal
extra_documents: Keep a scanned copy of the proof at hand; the portal rejects unclear uploads
documents: Your Aadhaar number (12 digits) or Enrolment ID
The mobile number registered with Aadhaar, to receive the OTP
One valid proof of address (recent electricity or water bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, passport, or another document from the UIDAI list)
For a name or date-of-birth change, the supporting proof listed on the portal

costs.label: Online update fee
costs.value: a small fee per update request, shown on the portal before payment

costs.label: Centre update fee
costs.value: slightly higher if done at an Aadhaar centre

where_to_go.note: If your mobile number is not registered or the online update is rejected, visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra with originals

processing_time: Usually 7 to 30 days after submitting the request.
warnings: Update Aadhaar only on myAadhaar or at an official Aadhaar centre
No one needs your OTP or Aadhaar number over a phone call; share neither
steps: Open myAadhaar and log in with your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Choose Update Aadhaar Online and select the field you want to change (address, name, date of birth and so on).
Enter the new details exactly as they appear on your proof document.
Upload a clear scan of the proof document in the accepted format and size.
Submit and note the Update Request Number (URN) shown on the screen.
Track the request online. If it is rejected or needs biometric confirmation, visit an Aadhaar centre.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Voter ID (new registration, Form 6)
mode_reason: Form 6 is filled and submitted online with document uploads, but a Booth Level Officer may visit or call for verification before your name is added to the roll.
compulsory_documents: One proof of age (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, Class 10 marksheet, or passport)
One proof of current address (electricity bill, water bill, rent agreement, bank passbook, or passport)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)
optional_documents: Mobile number and email for status updates
extra_documents: If you have moved recently, keep the previous address proof too — it helps the officer trace your record
documents: One proof of age (birth certificate, school leaving certificate, Class 10 marksheet, or passport)
One proof of current address (electricity bill, water bill, rent agreement, bank passbook, or passport)
A recent passport-size photograph (digital upload)

costs.label: Registration
costs.value: free on the official portal

costs.label: Photocopies for the officer visit
costs.value: a few rupees at any copy shop

where_to_go.office: Online (Voters' Service Portal), then your doorstep for BLO verification
where_to_go.note: No office visit is normally needed; the Booth Level Officer comes to you if verification is required

processing_time: Usually a few weeks; you can track it with your acknowledgement number.
warnings: You can be registered only where you actually live; false addresses can be rejected
e-EPIC download is free; never pay a website for a voter card
steps: Create an account on the Voters' Service Portal with your mobile number.
Fill Form 6 online with your details and current constituency.
Upload your age proof, address proof and photograph.
Submit and save the acknowledgement number you receive.
Track the application online and respond if the Booth Level Officer contacts you for verification.
Once approved, download the e-EPIC voter card or collect the physical card.
fee_note: Registration is generally free; see the official portal.

name: Passport (fresh application)
mode_reason: The form and appointment booking are online, but you must appear in person at a Passport Seva Kendra for document verification, photograph and biometrics.
compulsory_documents: Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, or another document from the portal's list)
Proof of date of birth (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, or another document from the portal's list)
Aadhaar card
optional_documents: PAN card or voter ID (extra photo ID helps)
Old passport or citizenship documents, if applicable
extra_documents: Carry photocopies of every original you take to the centre
A passport-size photograph as a backup even though the photo is taken at the centre
documents: Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, bank passbook, rent agreement, or another document from the portal's list)
Proof of date of birth (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, or another document from the portal's list)
Aadhaar card
Old passport or citizenship documents, if applicable

costs.label: Application fee (36-page booklet)
costs.value: shown on the portal at booking; paid online

costs.label: Tatkal option
costs.value: higher fee for urgent processing, if eligible

costs.label: Travel and photocopies for the centre visit
costs.value: plan a little extra for the appointment day

where_to_go.office: Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office PSK in your city
where_to_go.note: You must visit the centre on your booked appointment day with originals; find your nearest one on the Passport Seva portal

processing_time: Often several weeks including police verification; Tatkal is faster.
warnings: Appointments are free to book; agents who promise 'confirmed slots' for money are not official
Never share OTPs or full documents with touts outside the centre
steps: Register on the Passport Seva portal and log in.
Fill the online application form carefully, matching your documents exactly.
Pay the fee shown on the portal and book an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office PSK.
Save or print the appointment receipt (ARN) and application receipt.
Visit the Passport Seva Kendra on your appointment day with original documents and photocopies.
Track the application online; police verification is usually scheduled after your visit.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Learner's Licence
mode_reason: Application, fee payment and in many states the test can be completed online through Parivahan, but a visit to the RTO is needed for document verification and biometrics before the licence is issued.
compulsory_documents: Proof of age (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, passport, or similar)
Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, rent agreement, or similar)
Passport-size photographs
Aadhaar number, for e-KYC where your state supports it
optional_documents: Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness (usually filled online)
Form 1A medical certificate, where the portal requires it (older applicants, transport category)
extra_documents: Keep the fee receipt and application number handy for the RTO visit
documents: Proof of age (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, passport, or similar)
Proof of address (Aadhaar card, electricity bill, rent agreement, or similar)
Passport-size photographs
Aadhaar number, for e-KYC where your state supports it
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness (Form 1A medical certificate where required)

costs.label: Learner's licence fee
costs.value: shown on Parivahan at payment; varies a little by state

costs.label: Online test slot
costs.value: small fee where charged

costs.label: Medical certificate (if asked)
costs.value: doctor's fee at any registered clinic

where_to_go.office: Online (Parivahan / Sarathi), then your local RTO
where_to_go.note: Most states allow the learner's test from home; biometrics and verification need an RTO visit

processing_time: Learner's licence is often issued within days of passing the test; the RTO visit may need a prior slot.
warnings: Use only parivahan.gov.in or your state transport website; many lookalike sites charge double
The learner's licence is valid for six months and you must carry it while learning
steps: Open the Parivahan Sarathi portal and choose Apply for Learner Licence.
Complete e-KYC with your Aadhaar where supported, or apply with document upload.
Fill the application, upload documents and photographs, and pay the fee shown on the portal.
Book the learner's test slot; in many states the test can be taken online from home.
Pass the test on road signs and traffic rules.
Visit the RTO as instructed for document verification and biometrics, then download or collect your licence.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Ration card (new / add family member)
mode_reason: Many states accept the application online on the state food and civil supplies portal, but verification (sometimes a home visit) happens at the local office before approval.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar of every family member to be included
Proof of address (electricity bill, rent agreement, or similar)
Bank passbook of the head of the family, for cash-transfer linked benefits
optional_documents: Previous ration card or surrender certificate, if shifting from another state
Passport-size photographs of family members, where the state portal asks
extra_documents: If newly married, the marriage certificate helps when adding a spouse
For a newborn, the birth certificate or hospital discharge slip speeds up the addition
documents: Aadhaar of every family member to be included
Proof of address (electricity bill, rent agreement, or similar)
Bank passbook of the head of the family, for cash-transfer linked benefits

costs.label: Application
costs.value: usually free or a nominal fee set by your state

costs.label: Photocopies
costs.value: a few rupees locally

where_to_go.office: Your state food and civil supplies portal, then the local ration / tehsil office for verification
where_to_go.note: Where is your ration office? Ask at the gram panchayat or ward office; find district offices through the state portal

processing_time: Usually a few weeks, including field verification.
warnings: One family can hold only one card in most states; holding two can attract cancellation
Do not pay middlemen — the application and verification are free or nominal
steps: Open your state's food and civil supplies portal and choose the new ration card / add member option.
Fill the family details exactly as on each member's Aadhaar.
Upload the Aadhaar and address proofs for every member.
Submit and note the application or reference number.
Cooperate with verification if an inspector visits or calls.
Collect the card or download the e-ration card once approved, depending on your state.
fee_note: Varies by state; see the state portal for the current fee.

name: Income certificate
mode_reason: The form is filed online on the state e-district portal or at a CSC; the certificate is issued after the tehsildar or revenue office verifies your income details.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar card
Proof of address
Self-declaration or affidavit of annual family income
Salary slips, Form 16, or ITR (if salaried), or a patwari / village officer report (if agriculture or self-employed)
optional_documents: Ration card (accepted as address and family proof in many states)
Passport-size photograph, where the portal asks
extra_documents: Keep last year's income certificate, if you have one — it helps the office cross-check
documents: Aadhaar card
Proof of address
Self-declaration or affidavit of annual family income
Salary proof: salary slips, Form 16, or ITR; agriculture or self-employed: revenue officer report

costs.label: Application fee
costs.value: small fee set by your state (often free for some categories)

costs.label: CSC service charge
costs.value: a service fee if you apply through a Common Service Centre instead of yourself

costs.label: Affidavit / stamp paper (if needed)
costs.value: price of the stamp paper at a licensed vendor

where_to_go.office: State e-district portal, Common Service Centre (CSC), or the tehsil / revenue office
where_to_go.note: Find your nearest CSC or tehsil office through your state portal; in villages the gram panchayat office can guide you

processing_time: Commonly 7 to 30 days depending on the state and verification load.
warnings: The income certificate is often valid for one year only — check the date before submitting it somewhere
A wrong income declaration can lead to rejection and cancellation of other benefits
steps: Open your state's e-district portal and log in (or visit a CSC).
Fill the income certificate application with correct family and income details.
Upload Aadhaar, address proof and income proof.
Pay the fee shown and note the application number.
Track the application; supply any extra document the office asks for.
Download the digitally signed certificate once approved.
fee_note: Varies by state; see the state portal for the current fee.

name: Driving licence (renewal)
mode_reason: The renewal form and fee are handled online on Parivahan, but most RTOs need a visit for a photograph, signature and sometimes a medical form before printing the renewed licence.
compulsory_documents: Existing driving licence (original and copy)
Aadhaar card and proof of address, if changed since the last licence
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness
optional_documents: Form 1A medical certificate (needed for older applicants and transport licences)
extra_documents: Keep the old licence safe — it is stamped or cancelled during renewal
documents: Existing driving licence (original and copy)
Aadhaar card and proof of address, if changed since the last licence
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness
Form 1A medical certificate where required
Passport-size photographs

costs.label: Renewal fee
costs.value: shown on Parivahan at payment; differs for two-wheeler / four-wheeler (and with a late fee if expired long ago)

costs.label: Medical certificate (if asked)
costs.value: doctor's fee at any registered clinic

where_to_go.office: Online (Parivahan), then your local RTO if the state asks for a visit
where_to_go.note: Apply before expiry — many RTOs require the renewal application within 30 days of the expiry date

processing_time: Often days to a few weeks; some states apply a grace period after expiry.
warnings: Driving with an expired licence can mean a fine; renew as soon as it expires if you missed the window
Some states charge a late fee and a retest if the licence has been expired for over a year
steps: Open Parivahan Sarathi and choose Services on Driving Licence, then Renewal.
Enter your licence number and date of birth to fetch the record.
Fill the form, upload documents where asked, and pay the fee shown.
Book a slot at your RTO if your state requires a visit.
Visit the RTO with originals and photographs if asked.
Download the renewed licence digitally or collect it when ready.
fee_note: See the official portal for the current fee.

name: Birth certificate
mode_reason: The application is filed online on the municipal or e-district portal, but issuing the certificate involves the registrar's office checking hospital records, so one visit may be needed for old or missing registrations.
compulsory_documents: Hospital discharge slip or birth report with the date and place of birth
Parents' Aadhaar cards
Proof of residence in the municipal area
optional_documents: Marriage certificate of the parents, where asked
Ration card or address proof of the family
extra_documents: For births older than a year, an affidavit and a school certificate may be required; the fee is also higher
documents: Hospital discharge slip or birth report with the date and place of birth
Parents' Aadhaar cards
Proof of residence in the municipal area

costs.label: Registration within 21 days
costs.value: usually free or nominal

costs.label: Late registration
costs.value: higher fee, and may need an affidavit and the registrar's permission

costs.label: Extra copies
costs.value: small charge per copy at most municipal offices

where_to_go.office: The municipal corporation / nagar palika / gram panchayat that covers the place of birth
where_to_go.note: Hospitals usually file the birth within 21 days; if you are registering late, apply on the municipal portal or at the registrar's office

processing_time: Digital copies are often issued within days; late registrations take longer.
warnings: Register as early as possible — after 21 days the process becomes slower and costlier
Keep at least two certified copies; schools and passports ask for them
steps: Find the birth registration portal of your municipal corporation or the e-district portal.
Fill the birth details exactly as on the hospital record.
Upload the hospital slip, parents' Aadhaar and residence proof.
Pay the fee shown and note the application number.
Visit the registrar's office if asked for verification (needed for old births).
Download or collect the signed birth certificate.
fee_note: Varies by municipality; see the local portal for the current fee.

name: Ayushman Bharat card (PM-JAY health cover)
mode_reason: Eligibility is checked against government databases and the card is generated online from Aadhaar and mobile OTP; empanelled hospitals accept the card directly.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP
Ration card or SECC / state database entry showing eligibility
optional_documents: Panchayat or ward certificate, if your name is not found in the automatic eligibility check
extra_documents: Elderly family members can be verified with a face scan if there is no OTP phone; do this at a CSC or empanelled hospital help desk
documents: Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP
Ration card or SECC / state database entry showing eligibility

costs.label: The card itself
costs.value: free

costs.label: CSC service charge for help
costs.value: a service fee if you use a Common Service Centre instead of the portal

where_to_go.office: Online (beneficiary portal), a Common Service Centre (CSC), or the help desk of any empanelled hospital
where_to_go.note: Treatment cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals; the hospital help desk can verify your family

processing_time: The card is generated immediately after successful e-KYC.
warnings: The scheme is free; anyone charging a 'membership fee' for a new card is not official
Check hospital empanelment before admission; not every private hospital is in the network
steps: Open the PM-JAY beneficiary portal or go to a CSC / empanelled hospital help desk.
Enter Aadhaar and complete the OTP or face verification.
Check the family members listed and their details.
Generate the Ayushman card PDF and save it on your phone.
Carry the card and Aadhaar for any cashless treatment.
fee_note: The scheme itself is free; see the official portal for details.

name: PM-KISAN registration (farmer income support)
mode_reason: Self-registration is online on the PM-KISAN portal, but land records must match and the local patwari / agriculture officer verifies the details before the first instalment.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar card
Land records (khatauni / 7-12 extract / khasra) showing your name as owner
Bank account passbook linked to Aadhaar (account must be in your name)
optional_documents: Mobile number for instalment SMS updates
extra_documents: Inherited land? First get the mutation (namantaran) updated to your name in land records, then apply
documents: Aadhaar card
Land records (khatauni / 7-12 extract / khasra) showing your name as owner
Bank account passbook linked to Aadhaar (account must be in your name)

costs.label: Registration
costs.value: free on the official portal

costs.label: Land record copy / mutation updates
costs.value: nominal fee at the tehsil or land records office

where_to_go.office: Online (pmkisan.gov.in) or the nearest agriculture / CSC centre for help; land record work at the tehsil office
where_to_go.note: The patwari or revenue officer may verify the plot before approval in some states

processing_time: Weeks to a couple of months, depending on verification.
warnings: One family can receive benefits under one member's name only; duplicate applications get rejected
Check your status online before paying anyone to 'fix' a stalled application
steps: Open pmkisan.gov.in and choose New Farmer Registration.
Enter your Aadhaar and the mobile number you can receive OTPs on.
Fill land and bank details exactly as on the records.
Upload the land record copy where asked.
Submit and note the registration number.
Check the beneficiary status page; complete any patwari verification if requested.
fee_note: Registration is free; see the official portal for current benefit amounts.

name: e-Shram card (unorganised worker registration)
mode_reason: The whole registration is online with Aadhaar and OTP; when an OTP phone is not available, a nearest CSC (free of charge) completes it.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP
Bank account passbook
optional_documents: Ration card or address proof, where the form asks
extra_documents: Keep the occupation details ready (type of work and approximate monthly earning) — the form asks
documents: Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP
Bank account passbook

costs.label: Registration
costs.value: free; CSCs cannot charge for e-Shram registration

costs.label: Delivery of the physical card
costs.value: not needed — the e-card download is enough everywhere

where_to_go.office: Online (eshram.gov.in), or any Common Service Centre (free) if you have no smartphone
where_to_go.note: The e-Shram card is accepted as worker proof at many government counters

processing_time: The card is issued immediately with the UAN and downloadable PDF.
warnings: Registration is free; any CSC or person charging a fee for e-Shram is violating the rules — report them
Your e-Shram card is not a job guarantee; it is a worker identity and accident insurance gateway
steps: Open eshram.gov.in and log in with your Aadhaar and OTP (or ask a CSC to do it free).
Fill your personal, occupation and bank details.
Read the declaration and submit.
Note the e-Shram card number (UAN).
Download the e-card PDF and save it on your phone.
fee_note: Registration is free; see the official portal.

name: DigiLocker (digital document wallet)
mode_reason: DigiLocker accounts are created online with Aadhaar or mobile number and documents are issued into the wallet directly by government departments.
compulsory_documents: Aadhaar number, or a mobile number for the simpler sign-up
Mobile number for OTP verification
extra_documents: You can pull PAN, driving licence, school certificates and more into the wallet once verified
documents: Aadhaar number, or a mobile number for the simpler sign-up
Mobile number for OTP verification

costs.label: Account and most documents
costs.value: free

where_to_go.note: Legally accepted digital copies: DigiLocker documents are valid under the IT Act rules

warnings: Open DigiLocker only at digilocker.gov.in or the official app; lookalike sites can steal Aadhaar details
steps: Open digilocker.gov.in or install the official app.
Sign up with your mobile or Aadhaar and verify the OTP.
Set a PIN and complete your profile.
Choose the Issued Documents tab, pick a department, and fetch your documents.
Download or share documents with a verification QR when asked anywhere.
